metadata.task: Navigate to the sink, collect the dirty plate, and place it in the dishwasher.

plan.goal: Navigate to the sink, pick up the dirty plate, and place it in the dishwasher.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Washing Zone (Sink) to access the dirty plate.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the default spawn location (Near Kitchen Counter).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the Sink/Washing Zone.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 allows navigation to a specific object pose. Although the robot lacks autonomous navigation capabilities (fixed_base), this abstract skill defines the logical intent to reach the sink's location, which will be executed via a teleoperated or simulated movement command to the sink's coordinates.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the dirty plate from the Sink.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Sink with the dirty plate present.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the dirty plate.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 (pick_object) secures the target object in the robot gripper. The robot has dexterous manipulation capabilities (can_pick, can_grasp) and a single arm, making this skill executable via MoveIt2.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Dishwasher and place the plate inside.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the dirty plate.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the dirty plate in the Dishwasher.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_001 navigates the robot to the Dishwasher location.
Skill MAN_025 (insert_object) places the held object into the constrained target (Dishwasher). This requires force control and is grounded in MoveIt Servo.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base; navigation relies on teleoperation or simulated coordinate updates.
Robot has limited payload capacity; ensure plate weight is within limits.
Robot has limited contact interaction; insertion force must be controlled.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Robot successfully navigates to the sink, picks up the dirty plate, moves to the dishwasher, and inserts the plate.
